_note: Per-exercise overrides for the looping previews. The default is to start a third of the way into the clip and take 8s, which usually lands on the reps — but some clips put the good part somewhere else. Set 'start' (seconds) and optionally 'length' to fix one. scripts/make_previews.py re-cuts any exercise listed here on every run, so editing a number is enough.

11280029.why: KB goblet squat — the default cut landed on setup; the reps start right away.

15867683.why: Pogo jumps — the reps only start at 14s; the clip ends at 17.9s so the loop is shortened to fit.

c-box-jump.why: Cardio day — the clip fades in from black over the first second; the step-down version runs from 1s.

c-kb-swing.why: Cardio day — intro and talking until ~14s; the swings run 15–23s.

c-stairmaster.why: Cardio day — the title card runs to ~5s and the control panel starts ~14s; climbing in between.

c-burpee-target.why: Cardio day — the reps end at ~9s, then the OPEX end card.
